name: 1N270
description: Germanium DO-7 diode optimized for RF and detector use (AM/FM/TV detectors, RF probes, FM discriminators). Low ~0.3V forward drop at signal levels, but with a higher 100V reverse rating and low 0.8pF junction capacitance versus the 1N34A, so it's favored for RF and as a higher-voltage germanium clipper. Banded end is the cathode.

DO-7.notes: small glass axial body; the band marks the cathode.

typical_application: AM/FM/TV envelope detection, RF signal probes, FM discriminators; germanium soft clipping in fuzz/overdrive (higher PIV headroom than a 1N34A).
gotchas: germanium: high reverse leakage and wide part-to-part spread; measure Vf before matching pairs
low current/power handling - a signal/detector diode, not a rectifier
temperature-sensitive; bias and tone drift with heat
verified against a second-source (NTE) sheet; original JEDEC 1N270 was made by various, NOS parts vary
